text:
Light received from distant galaxies is observed to have a longer wavelength than the light
originally emitted. This is called redshift.
Which conclusion do astronomers form about distant galaxies from this observation?
A
They are all moving around each other.
B
They are all moving away from each other.
C
They are all moving in circular orbits.
D
They are all moving towards each other.

options.label: A
options.text: They are all moving around each other.

options.label: B
options.text: They are all moving away from each other.

options.label: C
options.text: They are all moving in circular orbits.

options.label: D
options.text: They are all moving towards each other.
